propositions: AGENTS.md documents the 800-LOC module-size gate but omits the C901 cyclomatic-complexity ratchet, leaving implementers unaware of a shrink-only enforcement constraint that blocks CI

The C901 complexity ratchet fails builds when functions gain new debt or exceed per-symbol ceilings recorded in .github/complexity-baseline.json (threshold 15), triggered by routine changes like adding CLI flags or guard clauses

Implementers discover the C901 gate only at pre-flight (make lint), forcing unplanned behavior-preserving extraction work after feature completion, as the constraint is invisible to behavioral tests and linters
The remediation for C901 failures is code extraction and structural refactoring, never baseline bumps, similar to the module-size gate but requiring different mitigation discipline
